issue_request: FHIR-12280 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 ExpansionProfile. It asked to replace the confusing nested include/exclude code-system structure with fixedVersion entries carrying system, version, and default/check/override mode, plus excludedSystem entries, and to explicitly represent overridden versions in expansion output.
initial_application: The request was pre-applied as svn revision 10048 and appears in git as 7e7c737adbf264a93b611e96e738654a2b54dbe3, which changed ExpansionProfile source to fixedVersion/excludedSystem, added the default/check/override processing mode, warned about override safety, and tied ExpansionProfile settings to expansion parameters.
additional_context: ExpansionProfile is no longer an active current-build resource: source/fhir.ini lists ValueSet as approved and comments ExpansionProfile as dropped. Later Published Vocab decisions FHIR-16337 and FHIR-16490 removed ExpansionProfile and moved the relevant behavior into direct ValueSet operation parameters. Current ValueSet $expand source contains exclude-system, system-version, check-system-version, and force-system-version, including the override safety warning and the SHALL that overridden versions be represented in expansion parameters.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The obsolete ExpansionProfile resource should not be restored or edited in core, and the active ValueSet $expand operation definition already carries the code-system exclusion, default/check/force version, and explicit-parameter semantics that remain applicable after later resource-removal decisions.
